name: cliqthemes/log-lens-core
description: Fast, local-first log dashboard and error tracker for Laravel, Horizon, nginx, and console logs.

suggest.ext-curl: Required only for outbound HTTP: the Linear, Alerting, and HTTP-ingest client plugins. The core dashboard and log ingestion work without it.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Only for the opt-in Postgres driver (LOG_LENS_DB_DRIVER=pgsql). SQLite is the default and needs nothing extra.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Only for the opt-in MySQL driver (LOG_LENS_DB_DRIVER=mysql). SQLite is the default and needs nothing extra.

scripts.lint: find src public bin tests database -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
